# Glass, ice and water past the painted skies (Synthwave, Moonlight), review124 (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as the test world
# starts: render distance 6, clouds fancy, standing at y 64). Since batch 86 the painted sky marks no depth on 1.21.1 to
# 26.2 (PaintedSkyType), so the clouds behind it show. But vanilla draws its see-through blocks (glass, ice, water,
# slime, honey) after the sky effects too, and the painted sky paints over every block past its own distance (0.9 of
# where the render-distance fog starts: 155 blocks at render distance 12). Solid blocks out there stay hidden, as
# before; see-through ones now show on top of the painted sky. On 26.3 the painted sky never marked depth, so there
# both refs should look like the new code. Nothing is fixed for this yet: it decides whether that trade is wanted.
# Three panels 170 blocks to the north, 20 to 60 blocks up (7 to 19 degrees above the horizon): red stained glass on
# the left, ice in the middle, stone on the right.
# 1. review124-panels-aurora (the vanilla night sky with the aurora): all three panels show, on both refs. The control.
# 2. review124-panels-synthwave / -moonlight: with mod_ref=90354691 (batch 86 without PaintedSkyType, with its option
#    test hook) no panel at all, only the painted sky. On main (and this branch) the red glass panel and the ice panel
#    float on the painted sky, while the stone panel to their right is gone (plain purple Synthwave or blue Moonlight
#    sky where it stands).
#    A player sees the same with a glass build, a frozen lake or a waterfall on a far hill, or the sea's surface in the
#    painted sky's fade just under the horizon.
# Run it on 1.21.11 (and 26.2 or 1.21.1), and with -f mod_ref=90354691 to compare with the painted sky's old type:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review124 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/review124.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review124 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=90354691 -f script=.github/checks/review124.txt

# A clear night that stays night; the lyrics to the south, out of the way, and no clouds in front of the panels
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set direction SOUTH
set layout LINES
set placement SKY
set sky AURORA
set skyStrength 0.7
set shootingStars false
set twinkle false
set skyPulse false
option clouds off
option renderDistance 12
sleep 15

# The three panels, 170 blocks north of the player (past the painted sky at 155, short of the fog at 173)
cmd execute at @p run fill ~-30 ~20 ~-170 ~-12 ~60 ~-170 minecraft:red_stained_glass
cmd execute at @p run fill ~-9 ~20 ~-170 ~9 ~60 ~-170 minecraft:ice
cmd execute at @p run fill ~12 ~20 ~-170 ~30 ~60 ~-170 minecraft:stone
look 180 -12
sleep 6
shot review124-panels-aurora

# 2. The painted skies
set sky SYNTHWAVE
sleep 6
shot review124-panels-synthwave
set sky MOONLIGHT
sleep 6
shot review124-panels-moonlight

# Back as the test world starts
cmd execute at @p run fill ~-30 ~20 ~-170 ~30 ~60 ~-170 minecraft:air
set sky AURORA
option renderDistance 6
option clouds fancy
set layout WORLD
set direction FOLLOW
look 0 -28
sleep 2
